han_stack.title: Summation and triangulation independence of Lorentzian spinfoam amplitudes for all LQG
han_stack.author: Muxin Han

scope_rule: The result is a formal composition statement. Beltran's causal alternative is defined on generalized EPRL-KKL vertex data for arbitrary 2-complexes and is explicitly proposed as a per-vertex replacement in multi-vertex discretizations; Han stack members are generalized EPRL-KKL amplitudes on the same member 2-complex index set and carry external lambda_f^{p_f} weights. This permits a formal causal member amplitude to be defined by vertex substitution while retaining the same member/multiplicity weight labels. It does not prove equality to Han's special half-link gluing kernel, finiteness or normalization of the generalized causal vertex, validity of Han's analytic face-factorization after replacement, cutoff removal, large-cutoff localization/triangulation independence, or physical UV-to-Regge/GR transport.
